newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Cargolux adds Chile to network from Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: Cargolux adds Chile to network from Nov 11.

text.p: Cargolux said it planned to add the Chilean capital Santiago to its air cargo network from next month.
The cargo airline will be offering a weekly Boeing 747-200 service between Luxembourg and Santiago, via Sao Paulo, from November 11, Cargolux vice-president Pierre Wesner told Reuters.
"While South America is a fast-growing region for airfreight imports, Santiago is one of the few centers in this part of the world which can also generate export traffic."
The Santiago stopover will be added to an existing Cargolux B747-200F service from Luxembourg to Sao Paulo.
Cargolux is to deploy one of its Boeing 747-400Fs on the Brazil route in its winter programme taking the number of weekly frequencies to three.
As well as its three B747-400Fs, Cargolux operates a fleet of three Boeing 747-200Fs and an additional one on leaseback.
Cargolux recently concluded an agreement with Boeing bringing forward an order for a fourth B747-400 from September 1998 to August 1997. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
